title: Agent Harness Profile 0.2 audit event
description: A CloudEvents 1.0.2 event in JSON format (application/cloudevents+json) with the profile's two extension attributes orbanprevhash and orbanalg, plus the documented CloudEvents extensions sequence, recordedtime and traceparent. Event hash = lowercase hex SHA-256(JCS(event)) over the whole event. Events MUST NOT contain raw personal data or raw free text from untrusted parties; use a keyed hash (HMAC-SHA-256, key kept off-chain) and a reference instead. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

propertyNames.description: CloudEvents attribute names consist of lowercase ASCII letters and digits; the profile also enforces the CloudEvents SHOULD of at most 20 characters.

specversion.description: Required. CloudEvents specification version. MUST be 1.0.

id.description: Required. Event identifier, unique within source.

source.description: Required. URI-reference identifying the audit log (one hash chain per source), for example urn:orban-harness:unit:example.

type.description: Required. Event type under com.orbanplatform.harness. Defined in 0.2: run.started, run.completed, approval.requested, approval.decided, action.executed, action.replayed, policy.denied, record.redacted.

time.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time at which the occurrence happened.

dataschema.description: Opt-In. URI of the schema data adheres to (CloudEvents dataschema).

subject.description: Opt-In. Subject of the event within source (CloudEvents subject), for example a task id. MUST NOT be personal data.

data.description: Required. Event payload (JSON object). Contains identifiers, digests, keyed hashes and references, never raw personal data or raw untrusted free text.

sequence.description: Required. CloudEvents sequence extension: decimal string zero-padded to 20 digits, starting at 00000000000000000001 and increasing by one per event of the same source, without gaps. The Merkle leaf index of an event is sequence minus 1.

orbanprevhash.description: Required. Profile extension: lowercase hex SHA-256(JCS(previous event of the same source)), or 64 zeros for the first event.

orbanalg.description: Required. Profile extension: hash construction identifier. MUST be sha256-jcs-v1.

recordedtime.description: Recommended. CloudEvents recordedtime extension: RFC 3339 date-time at which the event was recorded in the log.

traceparent.description: Recommended. CloudEvents distributed tracing extension: W3C Trace Context Level 1 traceparent of the span in which the event was written.

tracestate.description: Opt-In. CloudEvents distributed tracing extension: W3C Trace Context tracestate.

additionalProperties.description: Opt-In. Other CloudEvents extension attributes (extension intended). Values use the CloudEvents JSON types for String, Integer and Boolean. They are covered by the event hash.
